name: @vespeneventures/strategy
description: Upstream strategy machinery, not content: hand-rolled, dependency-free entity validators (facts, mission, positioning, markets, audiences, roadmap, brand essence/attributes/derivations) plus a typed reader that loads and validates a consumer's own strategy directory, a facts-traceability gate that scans prose and copy for numeric/superlative claims and fails when one cannot be traced back to a facts.json entry, and a brand-coverage checker that verifies brand derivations account for a consumer's brandable token slots. This package ships the schema and the checkers; every consumer authors its own values.
author: Calvin Hung
